app.title: Zero Mail
app.description: Reach inbox zero without giving up control.

footer.tagline: AI auto-triage you can trust with your real inbox. Built for Gmail, by a small team in Brooklyn & Berlin.

landing.tagline: Zero Mail triages your Gmail with rules you write in plain English — labels what matters, archives what doesn't, drafts the easy replies. You stay in the loop on everything that goes out.

peek.title: Three steps to reach inbox zero — connect, describe, review.

how.title: Three steps. No new inbox to learn.
how.desc: Zero Mail runs inside your existing Gmail. Connect once, describe how you want your inbox handled in plain English, and watch the queue.

step1.title: Connect Gmail
step1.desc: Sign in with Google. Zero Mail uses scoped Gmail permissions — never your password — and you can revoke access at any time.
step1.scope: Read & modify scope · revoke anytime in Google account

step2.title: Write rules in plain English
step2.desc: Describe what should be archived, labeled, or drafted. No filters, no boolean operators — just sentences like you'd give to an assistant.
step2.parsed: Parsed · ready to test on last 7 days

step3.title: Review the triage queue
step3.desc: Every action is logged and reversible. Approve drafts before they go out. Nothing is ever sent on your behalf.

feat.title: The boring features your inbox actually needs.
feat.desc: No agents. No multi-step workflows. Five tools that quietly remove decisions from your morning.

labels.title: AI labels
labels.body: Zero Mail reads each message and applies the right Gmail label — investors, customer, receipts, recruiters — based on the rules you wrote, not a fixed taxonomy.

archive.title: Archive suggestions
archive.body: Low-value mail is staged for archive with a one-line reason. Approve in bulk or let high-confidence matches archive automatically.

draft.title: Draft replies
draft.body: Drafts are written in your tone and saved straight to Gmail's drafts folder. You read every word before anything ships.
draft.head: draft.zeromail · not sent
draft.subject: Subject
draft.subjectVal: Re: Following up after our call
draft.bodyText: Thanks Alex — really enjoyed the conversation too. I'd be glad to share the deck format you mentioned. Wednesday at 2pm Pacific work for a follow-up?

tester.title: Rule testing
tester.body: Before a rule goes live, dry-run it against your last 7 or 30 days of mail. See exactly what would have been archived, labeled, or drafted — with no side effects.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.body: Every action — archive, label, draft, skip — is logged with the rule that triggered it and a one-click undo. 90 days of history. Exportable as CSV.

f1.title: Plain-English rules
f1.desc: Write triage logic the way you'd describe it to a teammate. We compile it into structured matchers.

f2.title: BYOK ready
f2.desc: Use OpenRouter routing or plug in your own OpenAI / Anthropic key. Your wallet, your keys.

f3.title: Auditable trail
f3.desc: Every automated label, archive, or draft is logged with the rule that fired and the message it touched.

f4.title: Vietnamese-first
f4.desc: Native VI / EN bilingual UI. Write rules in either language; we triage either way.

f5.title: No auto-send
f5.desc: Zero Mail labels, archives, and saves drafts. It will never send a message without your review.

f6.title: Revoke any time
f6.desc: Disconnect Gmail or delete your account from Settings. Tokens deleted immediately.

rules.title: Sentences, not filters.
rules.desc: Five rules cover most professional inboxes. Each one is editable, testable, and reversible.
rules.exampleQuote: "Archive newsletters, marketing, and receipts unless a charge is over $500 or it's a refund."

parses.title: How it parses
parses.body: Zero Mail extracts intents (archive, label, draft, notify), entities (newsletter, receipt), and conditions (amount, sender, thread state). It never touches mail that doesn't match.

cta.desc: Join the waitlist. We're onboarding 50 founders and operators a week, in order. You'll get an invite to set up Zero Mail with your real Gmail account.

note.title: Gmail-only · v1
note.body: We're going deep on Gmail before adding Outlook or IMAP. If you live in another inbox, leave your email and we'll let you know when we expand.

trust.desc: Auto-triage only works if you can fully trust it with a real inbox. We engineered Zero Mail around three hard guarantees — and made every one of them auditable.

c1.title: No auto-send. Ever.
c1.body: Drafts land in Gmail's drafts folder. You read, edit, and hit send. There is no setting that lets the AI deliver mail on your behalf.

c2.title: Nothing is stored long-term.
c2.body: Raw email bodies, LLM prompts, completions, and embeddings are discarded after each triage run. Only metadata and your audit log persist.

c3.title: Sanitized before AI sees it.
c3.body: Bodies are stripped of attachments, signatures, and quoted history, then truncated to a token budget before any model call.

c4.title: Every action is reversible.
c4.body: Pause triage with one click. Undo any archive, label, or draft from a complete audit trail going back 90 days.

p1.title: Drafts only — never auto-send
p1.body: Zero Mail never sends a message on your behalf. Replies sit in your Gmail Drafts folder until you press Send.

p2.title: We don't store email bodies
p2.body: Your messages stay in Gmail. We process them in memory to apply your rules, then keep only the headers and an action log.

p3.title: Revoke access anytime
p3.body: Disconnect from inside Zero Mail or directly from your Google Account. We delete your data within 24 hours.

login.title: Sign in
login.headline: Reach inbox zero without giving up control.
login.body: Zero Mail connects to Gmail with your permission. We never auto-send, and you can revoke access from Google in two clicks.
login.googleNote: We'll redirect you to Google to grant access.
login.termsPrefix: By signing in you agree to our

consent_denied.title: Gmail access was declined
consent_denied.body: Zero Mail needs Gmail access to triage your inbox. Click Sign in with Google to try again.

gmail_scope_required.title: Gmail permission missing
gmail_scope_required.body: Sign in worked, but Gmail access wasn't granted. Click Sign in with Google and approve the Gmail permission to continue.

permissions.title: What you'll grant
permissions.intro: Google will ask you to approve the following Gmail scopes. Each one is the minimum required for a feature you control.

r1.title: Read messages and labels
r1.body: Used to apply your rules. Bodies are processed in memory; we only keep headers and action history.

r2.title: Modify labels and archive
r2.body: Used to label, archive, and unarchive — every action is reversible from your audit log.

r3.title: Compose drafts
r3.body: Used to write drafts that wait in your Gmail Drafts folder. We do not have permission to send.

permissions.notGranted: We are not asking for: send, delete forever, or contacts.

connect.heading: Gmail is connected.
connect.body: Zero Mail needs a Gmail grant before later phases can watch, label, archive, or draft. You can revoke access anytime.
connect.callout: Drafts only, never auto-send — replies wait in Gmail Drafts until you press Send.

template.heading: Pick a few starting points.
template.body: A starter template helps Zero Mail understand how you want your inbox handled. You can change it later in Settings.

completion.heading: You're ready. Open Settings to review your choices.
completion.body: Zero Mail is now watching your inbox in audit-only mode. Open the audit log anytime to see what it would have done.
completion.next1: Audit-only for 24 hours — actions are logged, not applied.
completion.next2: You'll get a daily summary at 8am local time.
completion.next3: Switch to live mode any time from Settings.
